tasks.title: Create book endpoint (POST /books)
tasks.goal: Implement POST /books that creates a new book, handling JSON validation and storing in memory.

tasks.title: Retrieve book by ID and list books with query filters (GET /books/{id}, GET /books)
tasks.goal: Implement GET /books/{id} and GET /books with id, title, author, isbn, synopsis, q filters.

tasks.title: Delete book endpoint (DELETE /books/{id})
tasks.goal: Implement DELETE /books/{id} that removes a book and returns 404 for non-existent.
